description: This Java class 'AIMRespPositions' defines the response positions for the AIM (Account Information Management) responses from Authorize.Net in the context of the OFBiz accounting system. It maps response field names to their positions within the response data and provides methods to retrieve position information and the approval string.

classes.name: AIMRespPositions
classes.description: Defines response position mappings for AIM responses from Authorize.Net, extending RespPositions.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Returns the index position of the specified response field name, or -1 if not found.

methods.name: getApprovalString
methods.description: Returns the string '1', indicating an approval response.
